battle.name: 伊孫佐戰役
battle.brief: 1915年6月，意大利與奧匈帝國在伊松佐河展開激烈衝突，俗稱伊孫佐戰役。此役意大利軍依賴菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914機槍提供火力支援，該槍為當時少有的自動武器，顯著提升步兵的壓制能力。

kit.name: 菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914機
kit.history: 作為意大利軍第一款大量裝備的自動機槍，菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914在步兵班提供持續火力，並被裝甲車與固定據點廣泛使用。

countries: 伊孫佐戰役於一九一五年四月二十四日至二十九日在美索不達米亞下游舉行，戰場是今日伊拉克南部、幼發拉底河沿岸的納西里耶及其周邊。英方由英國印度軍與印度遠征軍A構成，作戰主力為第七師及第六師，旗下包含英籍營隊、印度部隊與廓爾喀營隊；印度當時仍受英國統治，不能把英方寫成兩個獨立國家。奧斯曼方面則是鄂圖曼帝國第十五軍指揮體系下的納西里耶守軍。英軍沿幼發拉底河北上，是為了清除通往庫特與巴格達的交通障礙；這是一場英屬印度陸軍進攻帝國防線的戰鬥，而不是一次地方部队與英軍的偶發衝突。
countriesEn: The Battle of Nasiriyya was fought from 24 to 29 April 1915 in lower Mesopotamia, around Nasiriyya on the Euphrates in present-day southern Iraq. The British side consisted of the British Indian Army and Indian Expeditionary Force A. Its principal formations were the 7th and 6th Divisions, containing British, Indian, and Gurkha battalions; India was still governed by Britain and cannot properly be treated as an independent belligerent. The Ottoman side was the Nasiriyya garrison operating within the command structure of the Ottoman XV Corps. The British were moving north along the Euphrates to remove the obstacle on the route toward Kut and Baghdad. It was therefore a campaign battle between the British Indian Army and an imperial defensive force, not an incidental clash between a local unit and the British.
people: 英方最高作戰統帥是印度遠征軍A司令約翰·尼克松爵士。他負責決定作戰目標、批准各次攻勢，並在直接進攻失敗後改令部隊轉向迂迴。第七師由珀西·萊克少將指揮，負責最初沿幼發拉底河推進的攻勢；其主要部隊為第三十旅與第三十五旅。第六師在哈里·斯特林少將率領下調到納西里耶戰區，投入British戰役末段。奧斯曼一方的納西里耶前線，通常記在阿里·伊哈桑帕夏名下，由他配置守軍、砲兵與預備隊。實際作戰中，尼克松負責全局，萊克與斯特林分別控制師級地面行動；阿里·伊哈桑則能利用熟悉的防線與短距離調動，让步兵、火砲和反擊在同一防區內相互支援。
peopleEn: The overall British commander was Lieutenant-General Sir John Nixon, commander of Indian Expeditionary Force A. Nixon selected the operational objective, authorized the attacks, and later ordered the force to turn from direct assault toward a flanking movement. Major-General Percy Lake commanded the 7th Division in the opening advance along the Euphrates, principally through the 30th and 35th Brigades. Major-General Harry Stirling brought the 6th Division into the Nasiriyya sector during the concluding phase of the fighting. The Ottoman commander usually identified with the front at Nasiriyya was Ali Ihsan Pasha, who controlled the garrison, its artillery, and its reserves. In practice, Nixon directed the wider operation, Lake and Stirling commanded the British divisional actions, and Ali Ihsan was able to coordinate Ottoman infantry, guns, and local counterattacks within a closely integrated defensive system.
kits: 英軍步兵主要使用短彈匣李－恩菲爾德Mk III步槍，口徑為點三〇三英制；廓爾喀營與多數印度營同樣配發這種制式步槍。英方重火力包括水冷式維克斯Mk I機槍、二〇一四年式QF十八磅野戰砲與BL四點五英吋山榴彈砲。奧斯曼守軍則可見一八七八年型毛瑟步槍、七點六五公厘口徑，以及QF八點七公分野戰砲。英軍與奧軍的步槍及砲彈不能互換，十八磅砲與四點五英吋榴彈砲也必須分別補充，因此同一條後勤線同時承載多類物資。各營的機槍、預備彈藥與附屬砲兵數量並不完全相同，但野戰電話、鐵絲、沙袋、壕溝與砲位掩體都是雙方實際使用的裝備。
kitsEn: British infantry principally carried the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III rifle in .303 British ammunition; Gurkha and most Indian battalions used the same standard service rifle. British firepower included the water-cooled Vickers Mk I machine gun, the 1914 Ordnance QF 18-pounder field gun, and the BL 4.5-inch howitzer. Ottoman troops were equipped with the Model 1878 Mauser rifle in 7.65 mm and with the QF 8.7 cm field gun. British and Ottoman rifle ammunition could not be pooled, while the 18-pounder and 4.5-inch howitzer also required separate supplies, so one transport route often carried several unrelated ammunition types. Machine-gun and reserve-ammunition allocations were not identical in every battalion, but field telephones, wire, sandbags, trenches, and artillery emplacements were all present on both sides.
tactics: 英軍先以第七師沿道路與河岸接近防线，第三十旅與第三十五旅分向阿拉伯堡及Battery外堡發動攻擊。砲火準備迫使守軍躲入掩體，英軍突擊部隊一度越過壕溝並奪取阿拉伯堡，但攻勢沒有同時向整條主防線展開。後續砲擊與步兵 assault交替進行， Battery附近一度出現滲入，卻未形成可供後續部隊擴張的完整突破口。奧斯曼砲兵從陣地側面射擊，利用斜射火力和未被英軍即時掌握的遮蔽位置切斷突擊縱隊；預備步兵則在英軍突破後填入壕溝，使每次局部推進都受到縱深消耗。第六師到達前線後，英軍在四月二十八日集中較多步兵與炮兵攻擊，雖一度進入外層陣地，仍未奪取納西里耶主線。夜間與翌晨的砲火及反擊使英軍無法保有已占外堡，遂在四月二十九日停止正面進攻。
tacticsEn: The British initially used the 7th Division to approach along the road and riverbank, with the 30th and 35th Brigades operating against the Arab Fort and the Battery outwork. Preparatory fire forced the defenders under cover, and assault troops crossed sections of the ditch and temporarily occupied the Arab Fort, but the attack did not advance simultaneously along the entire main line. Subsequent bombardments and infantry attacks alternated; troops entered the ground near the Battery, yet no continuous breach developed through which the follow-on force could expand. Ottoman guns fired from the flanks, using oblique fire and sheltered positions that the British did not always locate promptly. Infantry reserves entered the trenches after each British penetration and absorbed the advance in depth. Once the 6th Division reached the sector, the British concentrated more infantry and artillery in the strongest attack on 28 April. They entered some outer positions but did not take the main Nasiriyya line. Ottoman artillery and infantry counterpressure during the night and following morning deprived the British of their captured outer works, and the frontal attack ended on 29 April.
data: 四月十四日，英軍抵達並控制位於納西里耶與巴士拉之間的Shichr，作為下一階段集結與補給地；四月二十四日，第七師開始進攻。四月二十四日至二十七日，雙方持續炮擊，阿拉伯堡、Battery及主壕之間的反覆爭奪，使英軍沒有連續突破的時間。第六師由巴士拉方向調到後，第四師的攻勢在四月二十八日達到最高強度，但砲火未能完全壓制側射砲群，步兵也不能越過所有未清除的障礙；四月二十九日，英軍停止攻擊並退回較南的集結位置。後勤上，巴士拉是唯一成熟的基地，彈藥、糧食與器材先由幼發拉底河上的汽船及淺底船運到Shichr，再以牛車和前線車輛分送連隊與砲位。步兵彈藥須層層補充，十八磅砲與四點五英吋榴彈砲的彈藥分別計算。傷員以擔架或救護車向巴士拉後送。四月的酷熱、飲水需求及不斷射擊造成的消耗，使作戰不能只按進攻時鐘安排。
dataEn: On 14 April the British reached and occupied Shichr, between Nasiriyya and Basra, where they concentrated for the next stage and received supplies. The 7th Division began its attack on 24 April. From 24 to 27 April, both sides exchanged fire and fighting continued among the Arab Fort, the Battery, and the approaches to the main ditch, leaving the British no uninterrupted opportunity to enlarge a breach. After the 6th Division arrived from the Basra direction, the British attack reached its greatest strength on 28 April, but the artillery did not silence all the flanking guns and the infantry could not cross every uncleared obstacle. On 29 April the attack ceased and the British fell back to a concentration line farther south. Basra served as the only mature base. Ammunition, food, and equipment came by steamer and shallow-draft craft on the Euphrates to Shichr, then moved forward by bullock cart and other vehicles. Infantry ammunition was replenished through successive echelons, while 18-pounder and 4.5-inch howitzer ammunition were accounted for separately. Wounded were carried south by litter and ambulance. The April heat, continuing demand for water, and expenditure caused by sustained fire made a simple timetable of uninterrupted attacks impossible.
cause: 巴士拉於一九一五年四月十二日落入英方之手後，尼克松仍須清除納西里耶。這個渡河點位於英軍由巴士拉沿幼發拉底河向庫特與巴格達推進的必經方向，一旦守軍控制主線與河岸，英軍的船隊、陸路补给和後續部隊就必須另覓通道。英軍連續追擊兩週後，預期奧斯曼守軍會像在Sheikh Saad那樣退卻，因此計畫以有限砲火準備後迅速攻下外堡，再把突破口推向城鎮。實際戰況卻相反：奧斯曼軍已把主壕、側射砲位和預備隊配置成相互支援的縱深，幼發拉底河又限制了英軍從一側包抄整條陣地的可能。英方擁有不弱的野戰砲兵與較短的河運補給線，卻沒有足以一開始便摧毀深壕與連續砲位的重型攻城器材。造成碰撞的核心，是British追求迅速追擊與奧斯曼依據渡河要點進行持久防禦之間的戰法差距。
causeEn: After Basra fell to the British on 12 April 1915, Nixon still had to clear Nasiriyya. The crossing stood on the route by which the British were advancing along the Euphrates toward Kut and Baghdad. As long as Ottoman troops controlled the main line and riverbank, British shipping, landborne supplies, and follow-on formations had to seek another passage. After two weeks of pursuit, the British expected the Ottoman defenders to withdraw as they had at Sheikh Saad. Their plan therefore was to use limited preparatory artillery, seize the outer works rapidly, and drive the breach toward the town. The reality was different. The Ottomans had formed their main ditch, flanking guns, and reserves into a mutually supporting defense in depth, while the Euphrates restricted the British ability to turn the entire position from one flank. The British had powerful field artillery and a comparatively short river supply line, but they lacked the heavy siege weapons needed to destroy deep trenches and a continuous chain of gun positions at the outset. The immediate clash resulted from the British expectation of rapid pursuit meeting an Ottoman defense organized around a vital crossing.
impact: 納西里耶的正面攻勢失敗後，British沒有立即把第七師與第六師反覆投入同一片殘破壕溝。指揮部重新選擇更南的沙特拉一帶，利用河運器材架設浮橋，取得東岸橋頭堡，再把行軍方向轉向城鎮北側，企求繞過主防線。這種轉變延長了英軍沿河與穿河補給的作業，也迫使Osman守軍把橋頭堡與北面的聯繫視為新的主要危險。奧斯曼方面則利用延誤獲得數日重新布置的時間，把部分兵力與注意轉向庫特方向。伊孫佐因此成為一次清楚的戰術挫頓，而不是整個Mesopotamia戰役的逆轉：英方承認正面方法失敗，改以正面限制加側翼迂迴重新推進；但離開納西里耶主線也使英軍暴露於新的河流與後勤問題，後續攻勢並未因此變得輕鬆。
impactEn: After the frontal attack at Nasiriyya failed, the British did not immediately feed the 7th and 6th Divisions back into the same damaged trenches. The command selected a crossing farther south, around Shatra, used river transport equipment to establish a pontoon bridge and a bridgehead on the eastern bank, and then turned north of the town in an attempt to pass the main defensive line. That change prolonged the British river and crossing operations and forced the Ottoman garrison to treat the bridgehead and its northern communications as the new danger. The Ottomans used the delay to gain several days for redeployment and to shift part of their attention toward Kut. Nasiriyya was therefore a clear tactical check rather than a reversal of the entire Mesopotamian campaign. The British abandoned the failed frontal method and resumed the advance through a combination of frontal pressure and flanking movement. Leaving the Nasiriyya line also exposed them to new river and logistical problems, so the renewed advance was not made easier simply by turning away from the Ottoman guns.
result: 四月二十九日攻勢結束時，英軍未能奪取納西里耶主防線，步兵已占有的外堡也無法作為下一次總攻的可靠立足點，遂退回南面陣地。Osman守軍重新掌握受威脅的壕線與砲位，城鎮及渡河控制仍在第十五軍防區手中。就戰役直接爭取的目標而言，這是奧斯曼方面的戰術勝利：British的正面突擊沒有成功，河流通道也沒有立即打通。然而，這並不是奧斯曼永久守住納西里耶的結果。英軍其後在更南渡河並向北方展開，奧斯曼守軍於五月中旬在包圍完成前主動撤離。因此，較精確的判定是英方攻勢受挫、守方贏得時間與空間，而非英軍被永久逐回幼發拉底河流域。雙方確有傷亡，但原始戰報、部隊回報與後官方統計的涵蓋範圍並不一致，本實錄不列無法可靠核對的精確傷亡數字。
resultEn: When the attack ended on 29 April, the British had not taken the main Nasiriyya defensive line. The outer works already occupied by British troops could not serve as a secure base for another general assault, and the force withdrew to positions farther south. The Ottoman garrison regained control of the threatened ditch line and gun positions, while the town and its river crossing remained within the XV Corps defense area. For the immediate objective of the attack, this was an Ottoman tactical victory: the British frontal assault failed and control of the crossing was not immediately secured. It was not, however, a permanent Ottoman retention of Nasiriyya. The British later crossed the Euphrates farther south and moved north, and the Ottoman garrison withdrew in mid-May before the encirclement was completed. The precise result was therefore a failed British attack and an Ottoman gain in time and space, rather than the permanent expulsion of the British from the Euphrates. Both sides sustained casualties, but contemporary reports, unit returns, and later official totals used different coverage. This account therefore does not state an unverified exact casualty figure.
